org.eclipse.fennec.model.atlas.rest.clie._comment: Read side. base.uri is deliberately the SAME variable ModelAtlasPublisher~publisher reads for its own base.uri: a deployment reads the EPackages of, and publishes back to, one atlas, so one value configures both. The default is where model.atlas's docker-compose-jena.yml puts a local container, which keeps a local run working with nothing set. The scopes below follow the same rule one step further: MODEL_ATLAS_SCOPE names the scope read from, and when it is unset the publishing scope is used, because a deployment that renamed its tenant renamed it in both directions. 'jena' remains the last-resort default, which is the scope model.atlas's own compose file creates. The ~jena instance name is only a factory PID suffix and stays put: renaming it would strand existing configurations without changing which scope is read.
